Zone (verified in the model). Plan label cell converted with the ground-floor plan calibration (X = −18.8 + (px−1)·0.0400853, Y = 7.8 − (py−135)·0.040288), then ray casts into the original GLB (typical_rooms/probe_new.py, probe_new2.py): each wall face = median of 7 parallel casts at floor + 1.0 m, doorways and windows from scans 0.25 m inside each face at floor + 1.0 / 1.5 / 2.2 m, floor and soffit measured at 5 points in this room (floor 0.00, soffit 2.14 m above it). Doors: N wall -7.88..-6.78 to the ground corridor (open doorway). Windows on the s wall.

Photos. None for this room: No photos: typical layout.

Built as new objects. A precision cooling unit, a CO2 extinguisher, four server racks, a UPS cabinet. A ladder cable tray over the rack row, a split air-conditioner, blinds down on the windows. Fit check: every footprint inside the zone and clear of the doors (check_layout.py), every built object inside the zone and every 360 node ≥ 0.30 m from anything (check_scene.py).

Dropped (real scale, no shrinking).

  • a raised access floor (the 2.14 m soffit leaves no room for it: racks are 1.80 m with the cable tray above)

Differences. (1) The model has no suspended ceiling: a 600 mm grid with LED panels is built at 2.13 m. (2) Door openings and windows are the model's; a door leaf of the upper-floor scene stands open in this room's renders only. (3) The ground-floor soffit is 2.14 m in the model; real rooms are higher, so the cameras stand at 1.40 m.
